To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a low pressure gene delivery system can induce an effective Th1 response to a noncarrier DNA vaccine in the skin.

(1) direct delivery of naked plasmid DNA into the skin of mice by a supersonic flow gene gun can elicit a Th1 immune response; (2) this Th1 immune response is sufficient for the protection of mice against tumor challenge; and (3) the Th1 immune response can be further enhanced by using a plasmid DNA that contains a Th1 adjuvant.
the supersonic flow gun can induce a polarized Th1 response against tumor‐associated antigens.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a new gene gun that uses supersonic flow to accelerate particles to the skin surface.
the development of a novel low‐pressure gene gun and its application to DNA vaccination.
the development of a novel DNA delivery device, the low pressure gene gun, that can be used in clinical settings to induce an anti‐tumour immune response.

this study has shown that a low pressure gene‐gun can induce a Th1‐type anti‐tumor immunity by the delivery of noncarrier DNA vaccine into the mouse skin.
this new DNA gun is a safe, effective and inexpensive tool for DNA immunization.
the use of a supersonic flow gene gun to deliver DNA into the skin is a simple and efficient method for generating an effective anti‐tumour immune response.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were able to show that a noncarrier DNA vaccine delivered into the skin using supersonic flow can induce a polarized Th1 response.
the supersonic flow DNA delivery method is a safe and highly effective way of inducing an anti‐tumour immune response.

the direct delivery of naked plasmid DNA into the skin of mice by a low pressure gene‐gun induces a polarized Th1 immune response to tumor‐associated antigens and protects mice against tumor challenge.

direct delivery of noncarrier DNA vaccine into the epidermis by supersonic flow can induce a strong Th1 immune response.
the low pressure gene gun is a powerful method for delivering a DNA vaccine into the mouse skin.
the delivery of naked DNA vaccine into skin by the supersonic gene gun is a simple and powerful method to elicit a Th1‐type anti‐tumor immunity.
